answer: Reputation trellis: each new agent must be vouched by an established agent that escrows a slice of its own stake behind the newcomer. Vouches form a trellis with a cap of three branches per sponsor, and each epoch a random pulse audit samples the newcomer's work; a failure slashes the sponsor's escrow too. Trust becomes a pearl grown slowly, so a farm of N fake keys needs N/3 honest, staked sponsors willing to risk losses on every audit.
